<?php
/**
 * IoT Device Firmware Update Controller
 * Handles firmware distribution for edge devices in K8s cluster
 * Uses etcd-backed state for coordination between replicas
 */

namespace App\Controllers;

use App\Services\EtcdClient;
use App\Services\FirmwareRegistry;
use App\Services\DeviceAuthenticator;
use App\Models\FirmwareManifest;

class FirmwareUpdateController
{
    private EtcdClient $etcd;
    private FirmwareRegistry $registry;
    private DeviceAuthenticator $auth;
    private string $podName;
    private int $leaseTimeout = 30;

    public function __construct(EtcdClient $etcd, FirmwareRegistry $registry, DeviceAuthenticator $auth)
    {
        $this->etcd = $etcd;
        $this->registry = $registry;
        $this->auth = $auth;
        $this->podName = getenv('POD_NAME') ?: 'unknown';
    }

    /**
     * Device requests firmware update - uses distributed lock to prevent
     * concurrent updates to same device class
     */
    public function requestUpdate(string $deviceId, string $deviceClass, string $nonce): array
    {
        // Authenticate device using mTLS cert fingerprint
        if (!$this->auth->validateDevice($deviceId, $nonce)) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'code' => 401, 'message' => 'Authentication failed'];
        }

        // Get current firmware version for this device class
        $manifest = $this->registry->getLatestManifest($deviceClass);
        if ($manifest === null) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'code' => 404, 'message' => 'No firmware available'];
        }

        // Acquire distributed lock for this device's update slot
        $lockKey = "/firmware/locks/{$deviceClass}/{$deviceId}";
        $acquired = $this->acquireUpdateLock($lockKey, $manifest);

        if (!$acquired) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'code' => 409, 'message' => 'Update already in progress'];
        }

        // Generate signed download token
        $token = $this->generateDownloadToken($deviceId, $manifest);

        return [
            'status' => 'ok',
            'firmware_version' => $manifest->getVersion(),
            'download_token' => $token,
            'checksum' => $manifest->getSha256(),
            'size' => $manifest->getSize(),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Acquire update lock using etcd compare-and-swap
     * Prevents duplicate firmware pushes to same device
     */
    private function acquireUpdateLock(string $lockKey, FirmwareManifest $manifest): bool
    {
        // Read current state
        $current = $this->etcd->get($lockKey);
        $currentRevision = $current['mod_revision'] ?? 0;

        // Build lock value with our pod identity and manifest version
        $lockValue = json_encode([
            'pod' => $this->podName,
            'version' => $manifest->getVersion(),
            'timestamp' => microtime(true),
            'lease_ttl' => $this->leaseTimeout,
        ]);

        // Check if there's an existing valid lock
        if ($current['value'] !== null) {
            $existing = json_decode($current['value'], true);
            $elapsed = microtime(true) - ($existing['timestamp'] ?? 0);

            // If lock is still valid (not expired), deny
            if ($elapsed < $this->leaseTimeout) {
                return false;
            }
            // Lock expired, we can take over
        }

        // Attempt compare-and-swap using the revision we read
        // This ensures atomicity... or does it?
        $success = $this->etcd->put(
            $lockKey,
            $lockValue,
            ['lease' => $this->etcd->createLease($this->leaseTimeout)]
        );

        return $success;
    }

    /**
     * Confirm firmware was successfully applied
     * Releases the update lock and records telemetry
     */
    public function confirmUpdate(string $deviceId, string $deviceClass, string $reportedChecksum): array
    {
        if (!$this->auth->validateDevice($deviceId, '')) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'code' => 401];
        }

        $lockKey = "/firmware/locks/{$deviceClass}/{$deviceId}";
        $current = $this->etcd->get($lockKey);

        if ($current['value'] === null) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'code' => 404, 'message' => 'No pending update'];
        }

        $lockData = json_decode($current['value'], true);
        $manifest = $this->registry->getManifestByVersion($deviceClass, $lockData['version']);

        // Verify checksum matches expected
        if (!hash_equals($manifest->getSha256(), $reportedChecksum)) {
            $this->recordTelemetry($deviceId, 'checksum_mismatch', $lockData);
            return ['status' => 'error', 'code' => 422, 'message' => 'Checksum mismatch'];
        }

        // Release lock
        $this->etcd->delete($lockKey);
        $this->recordTelemetry($deviceId, 'update_success', $lockData);

        return ['status' => 'ok', 'message' => 'Update confirmed'];
    }

    private function generateDownloadToken(string $deviceId, FirmwareManifest $manifest): string
    {
        $payload = json_encode([
            'device_id' => $deviceId,
            'version' => $manifest->getVersion(),
            'expires' => time() + 300,
            'pod' => $this->podName,
        ]);

        $key = getenv('FIRMWARE_SIGNING_KEY');
        return base64_encode($payload) . '.' . hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $key);
    }

    private function recordTelemetry(string $deviceId, string $event, array $context): void
    {
        $telemetryKey = "/firmware/telemetry/{$deviceId}/" . time();
        $this->etcd->put($telemetryKey, json_encode([
            'event' => $event,
            'context' => $context,
            'pod' => $this->podName,
        ]));
    }
}
